# Examples

The pieces that ship with Cell studio, one plain-text file each in `examples/*.cells` (52 of them), grouped by their first genre tag and listed in the library's order. Open one from the title in the header ([ui/library.md](ui/library.md)).

<!-- Generated by tools/examples-doc.ts from examples/*.cells: run `npm run docs:examples`, do not edit. A test fails when it is out of date. -->
